startingDeck.vowels: A, I, U, E, O (2 each, 10 tiles)

?.name: Wildcard
?.rule: Becomes the letter that makes a valid word with the highest Spell Power. Scores 0. Cannot be upgraded.

!.name: Exclamation
!.rule: End of a word, end of each comma part, or after a single letter. Never alone. Consecutive ! add 2,4,6,10,16,26,42 SP (cumulative per run). Counts toward crit length. Ignored by relic letter checks.

,.name: Comma
,.rule: Joins words and/or single letters (A!,B! is valid). All-single-letter casts score Mult 1 without relics. Not counted toward crit length.

red.name: Red Paint · Might
red.d: +1 Might when played (+1 Spell Power to attack weapons this combat).

blue.name: Blue Paint · Robust
blue.d: +1 Robust when played (+1 Spell Power to defense weapons this combat).

green.name: Green Paint · Agility
green.d: Draws +1 tile when the word is submitted.

gold.name: Gold Paint · Fortune
gold.d: +1 Gold each time it is played.

slimy.name: Slimy
slimy.d: Spell Power is 0 for its first use.

poison.name: Poisoned
poison.d: Casting it gives you +1 Poison: you take damage equal to your Poison at the end of your turn, then it drops by 1.

lock.name: Locked
lock.d: Can't be cast until the lock counts down to 0 (1 per turn).

condemn.name: Condemned
condemn.d: Banished for the rest of this combat if still unplayed in hand at end of turn. It returns to your deck after the fight.

curse.name: Cursed
curse.d: Casting it gives you +1 Curse: if your HP is at or below your Curse at the end of a turn, you die instantly.

frustrate.name: Frustrated
frustrate.d: Casting it gives you +1 Frustrated: words shorter than (stacks + 1) letters deal 1 damage to you.

burn.name: Smoldering
burn.d: Still burning: if it is in your hand at the end of your turn, you lose 1 HP. Casting it puts the fire out.

fragile: Fragile tiles are banished for the rest of the combat after one use (created by Utility Belt, Rune Chisel, Jester's Brew, Battle Cry).

rewardSlots.paint: none: reward tiles are unpainted (paint comes from the Painter event, shop and wheel)
rewardSlots.level2Note: always Level 2 with the Laminator relic

fortified: Positive tile state: never discarded at end of turn, immune to tile debuffs. 10% on reward letters, 15% shop, 15% claw; Tempering Oil consumable (combat only).
